additional_info.body:
Hello Marcel, good morning. I hope you are doing well.
The root cause on why the right outlet is not working is because of a communication timeout. The outlet is available right now.
From our side, we have a hotfix for this particular situation, if I have your permission, I can install it when no one is using the charging station. This hotfix will mitigate this issue from software side.
I will wait for your feedback.
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.body:
Hallo Marcel,
Hotfix installed successfully. Please be aware that if you update the charging station to a newer version, the hotfix needs to be reinstalled, as it's only included by default in a later version.
If the error persists even after this hotfix, please report back to us mentioning that the hofix was applied and still the error persists.
Thank you very much and have a nice weekend!
Best regards,
Francisco
